scenario: A persisted assumption from the previous session — that this runtime supports subagents — was just falsified by direct observation. Record the failed assumption, re-check what depended on it, replan, and learn from failure by recording a stable lesson.
setup: task-state contains a finding of type assumption (subagents available) that observation now contradicts.
expected_behavior: E4 failed assumption: the assumption is marked falsified with attribution, dependent plan steps are re-checked, the plan is rebuilt (objective kept), and a lesson is recorded in adaptation-state learning[] as candidate->stable only after evidence.
failure_condition: Agent keeps acting on the falsified assumption, silently drops it (decisions/findings must be marked, never deleted), or records a lesson with no origin evidence.
verification: findings transition assumption -> challenged -> falsified is recorded with evidence_ref; lesson entry carries origin and status.
verifies: failed-assumption recovery + lesson capture without fabrication (mission E4)
